landing.title: Care that connects patients, doctors, hospitals and donors
landing.subtitle: Book appointments, keep your medical history in one place, find blood donors fast and look after your mental wellbeing.
landing.f1d: Find a doctor by specialty and book in person or online.
landing.f2d: Doctors refer patients and reports move automatically.
landing.f3d: Nearby compatible donors are alerted. Their location stays private.
landing.f4d: A private journal, mood trends and a supportive chatbot.
